live_read_policy: Bounded public reads only. No attachment downloads, credentials, browser or remote writes. A partial listing is not full discovery acceptance.

important_distinction.live_native_bounded_listing: A documented native listing path completed within explicit public-read bounds for one representative tenant.
important_distinction.live_configured_capture_only: The configured URL was fetched and parsed where possible, but upstream catalog completeness is unverified.
important_distinction.saved_capture_supported_automatic_path_u: Saved baseline input works; this does not prove the provider lacks an API.
important_distinction.guarded_browser_weblink_mechanics_implem: A concrete browser must satisfy the guarded origin contract; injection alone is not proof of a safe browser.
